# MAC lookup chaos rig — report

This file is generated by `tests/chaos_rig.py --md`. It is a snapshot of how `maclookup.lookup_detailed` handles a corpus of messy real-world inputs (Windows ipconfig / Linux ip-link / Cisco show / BIOS / OCR / multi-line pastes / Unicode / etc.).

**Result:** 73 / 73 cases match expectations (0 mismatch).

## Counts by classification

| outcome | count |
| --- | ---: |
| match | 45 |
| match_ocr | 2 |
| partial | 7 |
| none | 19 |

None. Every case in the corpus matched its expected outcome.
